findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_room, join_room, room_send, room_read, room_upload_link, check_updates · Private data: create_room, join_room, room_send, room_board, room_upload_link, leave_room · Public sink: room_send, room_upload_link · Destructive: create_room, room_task, room_upload_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_room, join_room, room_send, room_read, room_upload_link, check_updates · Private data: create_room, join_room, room_send, room_board, room_upload_link, leave_room · Public sink: room_send, room_upload_link · Destructive: create_room, room_task, room_upload_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
